title: Open-source intelligence analysis system used by CIA and ODNI reportedly breached
date_note: The page says only that the breach happened 'in recent days'; its own publication day is 25 November (Turkey time, 00:35, which is 24 November in UTC), so the day of reading in UTC is used.
org: CIA and Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI)
geo_basis: agencies' country as stated by the source; no city given, Washington used as the seat of the US government
summary: Sabah, citing the New York Times and sources close to the matter, reports a breach of an open-source intelligence analysis system used by the CIA and the ODNI. The sources said some non-classified information was exposed but did not say what was taken, and said classified information was not compromised. They also said other intelligence agencies may have been affected. Neither agency's own statement was read.
plain: Sabah, citing the New York Times, reports a breach of an open-source intelligence analysis system used by the CIA and ODNI. Sources said non-classified information was exposed and classified information was not compromised.
exec: Reportedly, a system used by US intelligence agencies was breached; sources told the NYT that classified information was not compromised and other agencies may be affected.

validation.note: Only Sabah (relaying the New York Times, which was not read) was read. No agency statement was read.
